provenance.why: Re-baseline on a leak-free, deduplicated test split. The original metrics.json was measured on a split with 2.72% dhash leakage (label_audit_leakage.json) and 1,286 images; this removes that so the reported numbers cannot be leakage.
provenance.cleaning: data_pipeline/scripts/clean_corpus.py -- 1,425 duplicate images removed, 52 images with conflicting labels dropped, 32 group representatives moved so no duplicate group straddles a split
provenance.conclusion: Leakage was NOT inflating the results: mAP@0.5 rose 0.511 -> 0.524 and classification fell within noise (0.8527 -> 0.8504). The originally reported figures are therefore trustworthy.
